# Pagelove Design System

> Multiple selectable designs for accessible, document-first apps. Read the catalog first; use the requested design or its configured default and mode. Each design has complete formats and its own DESIGN.md. Never assume the root default's white surfaces apply to another selected design.

## Selection

- [Catalog](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/designs/catalog.json): Default design/mode and registered IDs.
- [Design index](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/designs/index.json): Available modes, guide paths, exports and preview links.
- [Authoring and selection](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/designs.md): Default rules, migration and how to add designs.

## Guides

- [Overview](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/README.md): Formats, authority and quick start.
- [Design](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/DESIGN.md): Stitch-compatible visual guide.
- [Foundations](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/foundations.md): Themes, scales and optional profiles.
- [Components](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/components.md): Native controls, states and integration limits.
- [Document-first](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/document-first.md): Domain models, editing, persistence and recovery.
- [Games](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/games.md): Player experience, input, state, audio and performance.
- [Accessibility](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/accessibility.md): Contrast, focus, targets and responsive checks.
- [Formats](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/docs/formats.md): Conversion contracts and limitations.

## Data and examples

- [Foundations JSON](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/tokens/foundations.json): Editable values.
- [Semantic JSON](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/tokens/semantic.json): Editable light/dark roles.
- [Catalog HTML](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/examples/catalog.html): Offline-capable component examples.
- [Full context](https://github.com/pagelove/design-system/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Combined guidance, preserving attribution.

- [Product polish](docs/polish.md): Shared application composition, typography, spacing, state and responsive contract.
- [Working app screens](examples/workspace.html): Overview, collection/detail and settings in every design.
